summary: Figma crushed its Q2 revenue and earnings targets, yet the stock cratered nearly 15%. The culprit? Soaring AI costs that are growing more than twice as fast as sales.

chineseTitle: 为什么 Figma 股票下跌
chineseSummary: Figma 超额完成了第二季度的收入和盈利目标，但股价却下跌了近 15%。罪魁祸首？人工智能成本飙升，其增长速度是销售额增长速度的两倍以上。
